items.name: cue
items.title: Cue
items.description: Imperative React overlays with isolated Cue environments, typed shared components, and one shared backdrop.
items.docs: Install a local Cue configuration with shadcn Dialog and create overlays with cue.createOverlay(...). The generated backdrop uses the local Dialog wrapper, so DialogContent must not render a second backdrop. https://cue.vlkstudio.com/docs
